title: Conformal constraint weights and charged time-symmetric data

items.title: Conformal electrovacuum seed data
items.design_state: Defines smooth conformal electrovacuum seed data and its exact types, weights, units, and nonexistence scope.
items.statement: Let $\Sigma$ be a nonempty oriented smooth three-manifold without boundary. Let $\bar h$ be a smooth Riemannian metric on $\Sigma$, let $\psi\in C^\infty(\Sigma,(0,\infty))$, let $\bar E,\bar B$ be smooth contravariant vector fields, let $\bar A$ be a smooth symmetric covariant two-tensor with $\bar h^{ij}\bar A_{ij}=0$, let $\tau\in C^\infty(\Sigma,\mathbb R)$, and let $\Lambda\in\mathbb R$ be constant. references.locator: Section III.A, equations (3.4)-(3.12), defines the conformal spatial metric and electric-vector weight; this item fixes the broader seed data and SI-to-geometric interpretation.

items.title: Exact conformal electrovacuum constraint transformation
items.design_state: Derives the exact divergence, norm, trace, curvature, Hamiltonian, and retained momentum transformations from the stated seed and SI constraints.
items.statement: Use the smooth conformal seed data defined in this development on an oriented smooth three-manifold, and let $D$ and $\bar D$ be the Levi-Civita connections of $h=\psi^4\bar h$ and $\bar h$. Define $\Delta_{\bar h}\psi:=\bar h^{ij}\bar D_i\partial_j\psi$, with the Euclidean convention $\Delta=\sum_i\partial_i^2$ in Cartesian coordinates. Use the spatial curvature sign and scalar-curvature contraction fixed for induced data in the preceding Gauss-Codazzi convention. Let $e=\alpha^{-1}\psi^{-6}\bar E$ and $b=\alpha^{-1}\psi^{-6}\bar B$ be the SI-convention vector fields associated with the inherited constrained electrovacuum initial-data convention. references.locator: Section III.A, equations (3.1)-(3.12), derives the source-free electric divergence weight and the flat-background Hamiltonian equation in Gaussian/geometric units. The proof here gives the general three-metric, magnetic, trace, and SI-to-geometric calculation.

title: Conformal constraint weights and charged time-symmetric data — Examples

items.title: Extremal cylindrical puncture end
items.design_state: Verifies the equal-mass/absolute-charge branch has an infinite-distance cylindrical puncture end and no centered minimal sphere.
items.statement: Let $m=|q|>0$ in the one-hole Reissner–Nordström (RN) conformal-data family; this equality defines its extremal parameter case. Use the punctured spatial manifold $\Sigma=(0,\infty)\times S^2$. Then $\psi^2=1+m/r$ and the centered sphere $S_r$ has areal radius $\rho(r)=r\psi^2=r+m$. No centered coordinate sphere is minimal. items.title: Unscaled electric vectors fail the transformed Gauss law
items.design_state: Computes a smooth Euclidean counterexample showing the unscaled electric vector violates the transformed divergence constraint.
items.statement: The assignment $E=\bar E$ always preserves the source-free electric divergence constraint under $h=\psi^4\bar h$.

references.title: A. I. Alcubierre, J. C. Degollado and M. Salgado, The Einstein-Maxwell system in 3+1 form and initial data for multiple charged black holes, arXiv:0907.1151v2 (2009)
references.locator: Section III.A, equations (3.6)-(3.10), derives the divergence-preserving vector weight; this explicit counterexample tests the incorrect unscaled assignment.
